en.t: The oldest recorded eruption of Mount Fuji (Traditional Japanese date: Sixth day of the seventh month of the first year of the Ten'o (天応) era)
en.s: Mount Fuji (富士山・富士の山, Fujisan, Fuji no Yama) is an active stratovolcano located on the Japanese island of Honshu, with a summit elevation of 3,776.24 m (12,389 ft 3 in). It is the highest mountain in Japan, the second-highest volcano on any Asian island (after Mount Kerinci on the Indonesian island of Sumatra), and the seventh-highest peak of an island on Earth.

zh.t: 有记录以来最早的富士山喷发
zh.s: 富士山是日本本州岛上的一座活火山，山顶海拔3,776.24米（12,389英尺3英寸）。它是日本最高峰、亚洲岛屿上第二高的火山（仅次于印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛的克林芝火山），也是世界岛屿上的第七高峰。

en.s: The Viking raid on Galicia and Asturias occurred in 844. Many longships were lost in the attack and the fleet retreated to Aquitaine.

en.t: Sergius IV became the 142nd pope, succeeding John XVIII
en.s: Pope Sergius IV (died 12 May 1012) was the bishop of Rome and nominal ruler of the Papal States from 31 July 1009 to his death. His temporal power was eclipsed by the patrician John II Crescentius. Sergius IV may have called for the expulsion of Muslims from the Holy Land, but this is disputed.

zh.t: 教宗塞尔吉乌斯四世即位
zh.s: 教宗塞尔吉乌斯四世于1009年7月31日接替若望十八世，成为第142任教宗，任职至1012年5月去世。他名义上统治教皇国，但世俗权力受到贵族约翰二世·克雷申蒂乌斯压制。他可能曾呼吁驱逐圣地的穆斯林，但这一说法存在争议。

en.s: The Battle of Cravant was fought on 31 July 1423, during the Hundred Years' War between English and French forces at the village of Cravant in Burgundy, at a bridge and ford on the banks of the river Yonne, a left-bank tributary of the Seine, southeast of Auxerre. The battle ended in a victory for the English and their Burgundian allies.

zh.s: 百年战争期间，英法两军于1423年7月31日在勃艮第克拉旺村交战。战场位于约讷河畔的一座桥梁和浅滩处，在欧塞尔东南方向；约讷河是塞纳河的左岸支流。英军及其勃艮第盟军获胜。

en.s: The siege of Svetigrad or Sfetigrad (Albanian: Rrethimi i Sfetigradit) began on 14 May 1448 when an Ottoman army, led by Sultan Murad II, besieged the fortress of Svetigrad (now Kodžadžik, North Macedonia). After the many failed Ottoman expeditions into Albania against the League of Lezhë, a confederation of Albanian Principalities created in 1444 and headed by Skanderbeg, Murad II decided to march an army into Skanderbeg's dominions in order to capture the key Albanian fortress of Svetigrad.

zh.s: 1448年5月14日，苏丹穆拉德二世率领奥斯曼军队围攻斯韦蒂格勒德堡垒（今北马其顿科扎季克），围城战由此开始。此前，奥斯曼军队多次远征阿尔巴尼亚，对抗斯坎德培领导的莱什联盟；该联盟由阿尔巴尼亚诸公国于1444年建立。穆拉德二世于是率军进入斯坎德培的领地，企图夺取这座阿尔巴尼亚重要堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Rijmenam was fought in the early stages of the Eighty Years' War between the forces of the States-General of the Netherlands and those of the Spanish Governor-General of the Habsburg Netherlands, Don Juan de Austria, on 31 July 1578, near Rijmenam in present-day Belgium. The Spanish forces were dealt a strategic defeat.

zh.s: 八十年战争初期，荷兰联省议会军队与西属尼德兰总督唐·胡安·德·奥地利的军队于1578年7月31日在今比利时赖梅南附近交战。西班牙军队遭到战略性失利。

en.s: The Siege of Doullens, also known as the Spanish capture of Doullens or the Storming of Doullens, took place between 14 and 31 July 1595, as part of the Franco-Spanish War (1595-1598), in the context of the French Wars of Religion. After of ten days of siege, on 24 July, the combined forces of Henri de La Tour d'Auvergne, Duke of Bouillon, André de Brancas, Amiral de Villars, and François d'Orléans-Longueville, tried to relieve the city, but were severely defeated by the Spanish forces led by Don Pedro Henríquez de Acevedo, Count of Fuentes, and Don Carlos Coloma.

zh.s: 杜朗围城战也称西班牙攻占杜朗或杜朗突袭，发生于1595年7月14日至31日，是法西战争（1595—1598年）及法国宗教战争的一部分。围城十天后，即7月24日，布永公爵亨利·德·拉图尔·多韦涅、维拉尔海军上将安德烈·德·布朗卡、弗朗索瓦·德·奥尔良-隆格维尔等人率联军试图解围，但被富恩特斯伯爵佩德罗·恩里克斯·德·阿塞维多和唐·卡洛斯·科洛马率领的西班牙军队重创。

en.s: The Battle of Loyew (Belarusian: Бітва пад Лоевам, Ukrainian: Битва під Лоєвом, Polish: Bitwa pod Łojowem; 31 July 1649) was fought between the Zaporozhian Host against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day town of Loyew on the Sozh River in Belarus, a forces of the Zaporozhian under the command of Colonels Mykhailo Krychevsky, Stepan Pobodailo and Martyn Nebaba was defeated by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth's forces under the command of Prince Janusz Radziwiłł and Nobleman Wincenty Korwin Gosiewski.

zh.s: 洛耶夫战役（白俄罗斯语：Бітва пад Лоевам；乌克兰语：Битва під Лоєвом；波兰语：Bitwa pod Łojowem）于1649年7月31日爆发，是赫梅利尼茨基起义的一部分，交战双方是扎波罗热哥萨克军与波兰—立陶宛联邦军。战斗发生在今白俄罗斯索日河畔洛耶夫镇附近。米哈伊洛·克里切夫斯基、斯捷潘·波博达伊洛和马尔廷·涅巴巴上校率领的扎波罗热哥萨克军被亚努什·拉齐维乌亲王和贵族温琴蒂·科尔温·戈谢夫斯基指挥的联邦军击败。

en.s: The Battle of Scheveningen (also known as the Battle of Texel or the Battle of Ter Heijde) was the final naval battle of the First Anglo-Dutch War. It took place on 31 July 1653 (10 August Gregorian calendar) between the fleets of the Commonwealth of England and the United Provinces, and had no clear victory. The name Battle of Texel may be questionable. There are two other known sea battles of that name (1673 and 1694), both fought near the island of Texel. However, Ter Heijde lies approximately 140 km south of Texel, which makes it unlikely that the reference to Texel is correct.

zh.s: 斯海弗宁恩海战也称特塞尔海战或泰尔海德海战，是第一次英荷战争的最后一场海战。1653年7月31日（公历8月10日），英格兰共和国与联合省舰队交战，双方没有明确胜负。“特塞尔海战”这一名称可能有误：1673年和1694年还发生过另外两场同名海战，地点都在特塞尔岛附近；而泰尔海德位于特塞尔岛以南约140公里，因此此处称“特塞尔”不太可能准确。

en.s: The siege of Dyneburg by the Russian Army under Tsar Alexei Mikhailovich was one of the first events of the Russo-Swedish War (1656–1658), a theater of the Second Northern War. The siege began on 18 July 1656. One night in early August, the Russian bombardment caused a fire in the grain reserves of the stronghold. Consequently, some of the garrison had to leave the defences to begin putting it down.

zh.s: 沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇率领俄军围攻迪讷堡，是1656—1658年俄瑞战争（第二次北方战争的一个战场）的早期事件之一。围城于1656年7月18日开始。8月初的一个夜晚，俄军炮击引燃要塞的粮食储备，部分守军因此不得不离开防御阵地前去灭火。

en.s: Alamgir I (Muhi al-Din Muhammad; 3 November 1618 – 3 March 1707), commonly known by the title Aurangzeb, was the sixth Mughal emperor, reigning from 1658 until his death in 1707. Under his reign, the Mughal Empire reached its greatest extent, with territory spanning nearly the entirety of the Indian subcontinent. Aurangzeb and the Mughals belonged to a branch of the Timurid dynasty.

zh.s: 阿拉姆吉尔一世（穆希·丁·穆罕默德；1618年11月3日—1707年3月3日），通常以尊号奥朗则布闻名，是第六位莫卧儿皇帝，1658年即位，在位至1707年去世。在他统治期间，莫卧儿帝国疆域达到最大，几乎覆盖整个印度次大陆。奥朗则布及莫卧儿王朝属于帖木儿王朝的一个分支。

en.s: The Battle of Newtownbutler took place near Enniskillen in County Fermanagh, Ireland, in 1689 and was part of the Williamite War in Ireland between the forces of William III and Mary II and those of King James II.

en.s: The Battle of Warsaw (also known as Battle of Rakowitz) took place on 31 July 1705 near Warsaw. Swedish forces under Carl Nieroth defeated the Polish-Lithuanian-Saxonian forces under Otto Arnold von Paykull.

en.s: The Battle of Balapur marked a civil conflict among Mughal leaders, triggered by the uprising of the Sayyid Brothers. This uprising led to a decline in the status of other Mughal leaders. The conflicts unfolded in 1720, following Nizam-u'l-Mulk's triumph over the Sayyid forces, supported by Rajputs, Marathas, and Afghans. The Sayyid forces faced successive defeats at both Burhanpur and Balapur against the Nizam forces.

zh.s: 巴拉普尔之战是莫卧儿领导人之间的一场内战，由赛义德兄弟起义引发，导致其他莫卧儿领导人的地位下降。1720年，尼扎姆·乌尔·穆尔克击败赛义德军队后，冲突随之展开。赛义德军队得到拉杰普特人、马拉塔人和阿富汗人的支持，后来在布尔汉布尔和巴拉普尔接连被尼扎姆一方击败。

en.s: The Battle of Beauport, also known as the Battle of Montmorency, fought on 31 July 1759, was an important confrontation between the British and French Armed Forces during the Seven Years' War (also known as the French and Indian War and the War of Conquest) of the French province of Canada. The attack conducted by the British against the French defense line of Beauport, some five kilometres (3.1 mi) east of Quebec was checked, and the British soldiers of General James Wolfe retreated with 443 casualties and losses.

zh.s: 博波尔战役又称蒙莫朗西战役，于1759年7月31日爆发，是七年战争期间英法两军在法属加拿大的一场重要交战。英军进攻位于魁北克以东约5公里（3.1英里）的法军博波尔防线，但被击退。詹姆斯·沃尔夫将军麾下英军撤退，伤亡共443人。

en.s: The Battle of Warburg was fought on 31 July 1760 during the Seven Years' War. The battle was a victory for the Hanoverians and the British against a slightly larger French army. The victory meant the Anglo-German allies had successfully defended Westphalia from the French by preventing a crossing of the Diemel River, but were forced to abandon the allied state of Hesse-Kassel to the south.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，瓦尔堡战役于1760年7月31日打响。汉诺威和英国联军击败了兵力略多的法国军队。联军阻止法军渡过迪默尔河，成功守住威斯特法伦，但被迫放弃南面的盟国黑森-卡塞尔。

en.s: The Battle of Bloody Run was fought during Pontiac's War on July 31, 1763, near what now is the site of Elmwood Cemetery in the Eastside Historic Cemetery District of Detroit, Michigan. In an attempt to break Pontiac's siege of Fort Detroit, about 250 British troops attempted to make a surprise attack on Pontiac's encampment.

zh.s: 庞蒂亚克战争期间，血河战役于1763年7月31日在今密歇根州底特律东区历史墓园的埃尔姆伍德公墓附近打响。约250名英军试图突袭庞蒂亚克的营地，以打破他对底特律堡的围困。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: The U.S. Second Continental Congress passes a resolution that the services of Gilbert du Motier, Marquis de Lafayette "be accepted, and that, in consideration of his zeal, illustrious family and connexions, he have the rank and commission of major-general of the United States."

zh.s: 第二届大陆会议（1775—1781年）由十三个殖民地的代表组成，他们团结起来支持美国革命和独立战争，最终促成美国脱离英国独立。会议建立了一个新的联邦，最初称为“北美联合殖民地”，并于1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。
zh.n: 美国第二届大陆会议通过决议，接受吉尔伯特·迪·莫蒂埃（拉法耶特侯爵）的服务，并考虑到他的热忱、显赫家世和人脉，授予他美国少将军衔。

en.s: The Action of 31 July 1793 was an inconclusive engagement between a British Royal Navy frigate and French frigate off the New Jersey coastline in the first year of the French Revolutionary Wars. The British captain, George Courtenay of HMS Boston, had arrived off New York City on 28 May and deliberately disguised his ship as a French vessel, fooling a French officer into coming aboard and making him a prisoner of war. Courtenay then sent a message into New York, where he knew a French frigate lay at anchor, challenging the French captain to battle within the next three days.

zh.s: 1793年7月31日，法国大革命战争爆发后的第一年，一艘英国皇家海军护卫舰与一艘法国护卫舰在新泽西海岸外交战，未分胜负。5月28日，英国“波士顿”号舰长乔治·考特尼抵达纽约市外海，故意将军舰伪装成法国船只，骗一名法国军官登舰并将其俘虏。随后考特尼向纽约送信，向他知道停泊在当地的一艘法国护卫舰舰长发出挑战，要求三天内交战。

en.s: The action of 31 July 1811 was a minor naval engagement fought between the Royal Navy and the French Imperial Navy during the British invasion of Java in 1811. On 31 July 1811, Commander Maunsell of the sloop the Procris discovered a convoy of 40 or 50 proas, escorted by six French gun-boats in the mouth of the Indramayo river.

zh.s: 1811年英国入侵爪哇期间，英国皇家海军与法国帝国海军于7月31日发生小规模海战。英国“普罗克里斯”号单桅帆船指挥官曼塞尔在因德拉马约河口发现一支由6艘法国炮艇护航的船队，其中有40至50艘帕拉胡船。

en.s: The Battle of Taguanes was fought between Spanish royalists and the Second Republic of Venezuela on July 31, 1813 during the Admirable Campaign of the War of Venezuelan Independence. Simon Bolivar and his patriots won the battle handily, defeating the Spanish (and killing their colonel) and eventually capturing Valencia on August 2 and Caracas on August 3.

zh.s: 委内瑞拉独立战争期间的卓越战役中，西班牙保王军与委内瑞拉第二共和国军队于1813年7月31日展开塔瓜内斯战役。西蒙·玻利瓦尔及其支持者大获全胜，击败西班牙军并杀死其上校，随后于8月2日攻占巴伦西亚、8月3日攻占加拉加斯。

en.s: The Battle of Matasiete was a battle in the Venezuelan War of Independence that took place on 31 July 1817 near the city of La Asunción on Isla Margarita in Venezuela.It was fought between pro-independence Republican revolutionaries led by Francisco Esteban Gómez and Spanish Royalist forces under the command of Pablo Morillo.The outcome was a Spanish defeat.

zh.s: 1817年7月31日，委内瑞拉独立战争中的马塔谢特战役在玛格丽塔岛拉阿松西翁市附近打响。弗朗西斯科·埃斯特班·戈麦斯率领的共和派独立革命军与巴勃罗·莫里略指挥的西班牙保王军交战，最终西班牙军战败。

en.s: The siege of Caxias was a siege during the Brazilian War of Independence in which the Brazilian Army under the command of José Pereira Filgueiras attempted to capture the city of Caxias in Maranhão, which was defended by the Portuguese Army of João José da Cunha Fidié. The siege lasted from 23 May 1823 until 31 July 1823, when the Portuguese surrendered to the Brazilian forces after the combats that occurred between 17 July and 19 July that severely reduced its numbers.

zh.s: 巴西独立战争期间，何塞·佩雷拉·菲利格拉斯率领巴西军队围攻马拉尼昂州卡西亚斯市，守军由若昂·若泽·达库尼亚·菲迪埃率领的葡萄牙军队组成。围城从1823年5月23日持续至7月31日。7月17日至19日的战斗使葡军兵力大减，最终于7月31日向巴西军队投降。

en.s: The Battle of Segesvár (Transylvania, now Sighişoara, Romania) was a battle in the Hungarian Revolution of 1848, fought on 31 July 1849 between the Hungarian revolutionary army supplemented by Polish volunteers under the command of General Józef Bem and the Russian V Corps under General Alexander von Lüders in ally with the Austrian army led by General Eduard Clam-Gallas. The battle was won by the Russian-Austrian army and it is presumed that the Hungarian poet and national hero Sándor Petőfi died in the battlefield, though his body was never found.

zh.s: 舍盖什堡战役发生于匈牙利1848年革命期间，1849年7月31日在特兰西瓦尼亚舍盖什堡（今罗马尼亚锡吉什瓦拉）展开。约瑟夫·贝姆将军指挥的匈牙利革命军与波兰志愿者，对阵亚历山大·冯·吕德斯将军指挥的俄军第五军团及爱德华·克拉姆-加拉斯将军率领的奥军。俄奥联军获胜；匈牙利诗人、民族英雄裴多菲·山多尔被认为在战场上阵亡，但遗体始终未找到。

en.s: The bombardment of Qui Nhơn in 1861 was an attack by a United States Navy warship upon a Vietnamese-held fort protecting Qui Nhơn on the south central coast of Vietnam (modern-day Binh Dinh Province). en.t: Patrick Francis Healy was inaugurated as president of Georgetown University, becoming the first African-American president of a predominantly white university in the United States
en.s: Patrick Francis Healy (February 27, 1834 – January 10, 1910) was an American Catholic priest and Jesuit who was an influential president of Georgetown University, becoming known as its "second founder". The university's flagship building, Healy Hall, bears his name. Though he considered himself and was widely accepted as White, Healy was posthumously recognized as the first Black American to earn a PhD, as well as the first to enter the Jesuit order and to become the president of a predominantly White university.

zh.t: 帕特里克·弗朗西斯·希利就任乔治城大学校长，成为美国以白人为主的大学首位非裔校长
zh.s: 帕特里克·弗朗西斯·希利（1834年2月27日—1910年1月10日）是美国天主教神父和耶稣会士，曾任乔治城大学校长，影响深远，被称为该校的“第二位创校者”。学校的标志性建筑希利楼以他命名。希利自认是白人，生前也普遍被视为白人；他去世后被认定为首位获得博士学位、加入耶稣会并出任以白人为主大学校长的非裔美国人。

Black church, Turkish: Karakilise Muharebesi), also known as the Battle of Malazgirt, was fought on the Caucasus front in July 1915 after the Battle of Manzikert. en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 31 July 1932, following the premature dissolution of the Reichstag. They saw great gains by the Nazi Party, which for the first time became the largest party in parliament, though without winning a majority. With the Communists remaining strong, anti-republican parties together now had a majority in the Reichstag (called a "negative majority" by contemporary observers since the two parties would never have allied), making a (majority) government by any union of pro-republican parties impossible.

zh.s: 德国国会提前解散后，于1932年7月31日举行联邦选举。纳粹党大幅增加席位，首次成为议会第一大党，但未获多数席位。共产党仍保持强势，反共和政党合计在国会中占多数。由于这两党不可能结盟，当时的观察人士称之为“消极多数”；共和派政党也因此无法联合组建多数政府。

en.s: World War II, or the Second World War (1 September 1939 – 2 September 1945), was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Nearly all of the world's countries participated, with many engaging in total war on an unprecedented scale. World War II was the deadliest conflict in history, causing the deaths of 60 to 75 million people, a majority of whom were civilians.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战（1939年9月1日—1945年9月2日）是同盟国与轴心国两大阵营之间的全球性冲突。几乎所有国家都参与其中，许多国家以前所未有的规模投入总体战。第二次世界大战是历史上伤亡最惨重的冲突，造成6,000万至7,500万人死亡，其中大多数是平民。

The Ruhr was the main centre of German heavy industry with coke plants, steelworks, armaments factories and ten synthetic oil plants. The British attacked 26 targets identified in the Combined Bomber Offensive.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Cyprus in 1960. The House of Representatives was elected on 31 July 1960, whilst the Communal Chambers were elected on 7 August. en.s: The Claudy bombing occurred on 31 July 1972, when three car bombs exploded mid-morning on the Main Street of Claudy in County Londonderry, Northern Ireland. The attack killed nine civilians, and became known as "Bloody Monday". Those who planted the bombs had attempted to send a warning before the explosions took place. The warning was delayed, however, because the telephones were out of order due to an earlier bomb attack. The Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) issued an immediate denial of responsibility, and later claimed that "an internal court of inquiry" had found that its local unit did not carry out the attack.

zh.s: 1972年7月31日上午，三枚汽车炸弹在北爱尔兰伦敦德里郡克劳迪主街爆炸，造成9名平民死亡。此次袭击后来被称为“血腥星期一”。埋放炸弹的人曾试图在爆炸前发出警告，但此前的一次炸弹袭击导致电话故障，警告未能及时传达。爱尔兰共和军临时派立即否认对此负责，后来又称其内部调查法庭认定当地分队没有实施袭击。

en.s: Delta Air Lines Flight 723 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by a McDonnell Douglas DC-9 twin-engine jetliner, from Burlington, Vermont, to Logan International Airport in Boston, Massachusetts, with an intermediate stop in Manchester, New Hampshire. On July 31, 1973, at 11:08 a.m., while on an instrument landing system (ILS) instrument approach into Logan in low clouds and fog, the aircraft descended below the glidepath, struck a seawall, and crashed.

zh.s: 达美航空723号航班由麦克唐纳·道格拉斯DC-9双发客机执飞，是一班从佛蒙特州伯灵顿飞往马萨诸塞州波士顿洛根国际机场的定期国内客运航班，中途停靠新罕布什尔州曼彻斯特。1973年7月31日上午11时08分，飞机在低云和浓雾中使用仪表着陆系统进近洛根机场时，低于下滑道高度，撞上防波堤后坠毁。

en.t: The Troubles: In a botched paramilitary attack, three members of the popular Miami Showband and two Ulster Volunteer Force gunmen were killed in County Down, Northern Ireland

en.s: START I (Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) was a bilateral treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union on the reduction and the limitation of strategic offensive arms. The treaty was signed on 31 July 1991 and entered into force on 5 December 1994. The treaty barred its signatories from deploying more than 6,000 nuclear warheads and a total of 1,600 intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs) and bombers.

en.s: The Discovery Program is a series of Solar System exploration missions funded by the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) through its Planetary Missions Program Office. The cost of each mission is capped at a lower level than missions from NASA's New Frontiers or Flagship Programs. As a result, Discovery missions tend to be more focused on a specific scientific goal rather than serving a general purpose.
en.n: Discovery Program: Lunar Prospector: NASA intentionally crashes the spacecraft into the Moon, thus ending its mission to detect frozen water on the Moon's surface.

zh.s: 发现计划是美国国家航空航天局（NASA）通过其行星任务办公室资助的一系列太阳系探测任务。每项任务的经费上限都低于“新前沿计划”或旗舰计划的任务。因此，发现计划的任务通常聚焦于特定科学目标，而非承担广泛用途。

en.s: Elections for the President of Israel were held in the Knesset on 31 July 2000, following Ezer Weizman's resignation. Moshe Katsav, a prominent Likud politician, ran against Shimon Peres, a previous Prime Minister of Israel. In a surprising upset, the Knesset elected Katsav, by 63 to 57. Katsav assumed office as President on 1 August 2000. He was the first President of Israel to have been sworn in for a seven-year term, as well as the first candidate from the right-wing Likud party to be elected to the office.

en.s: The final of UEFA Women's Euro 2022 took place on 31 July 2022 at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The match was contested between hosts England, who won, and Germany. For England, this was their third appearance in a European Championship final and the first since 2009, when they lost to Germany. England also lost in their first final in 1984, when Sweden beat them 4–3 on penalties.

en.s: The 2022 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final was the 49th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 2022 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship, an inter-county ladies' Gaelic football tournament for the county teams of Ireland.
